coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the two baseline prompts and per-task accuracy comparisons. The latter matches the outcome measure but omits the specified improvement target.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 27 BBH tasks instead of 23; does not specify PaLM 2-L-IT as optimizer with text-bison as scorer; omits the 20% optimization/80% testing split and optimization starting from an empty instruction. Instead, it evaluates a fixed, provisional OPRO prompt. It also omits final training accuracy and the target of >5% improvement in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to conclude that optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on most tasks, supporting OPRO's superiority over standard or naive instructions.
